stopped_because: ran the 5 iterations it was given

fields.name: picks_done
fields.description: Count of container pick-ups completed so far. 0 at step #1. Increases by one only at a decision step whose own final scene (the observation at the decision step itself, after the last execution step) shows a container held in the gripper, i.e. the step reached right after a 'pick up the container' subgoal finished. At a decision step whose final scene shows nothing held, the value is carried unchanged, even if earlier execution steps at that decision step still showed the container held before it was released (the step reached right after a put-down). e.g. 1

fields.name: goal_cube_positions
fields.description: Ordered list of the [y, x] positions of the cubes named in the goal instruction, in the order the goal names them, as those cubes were seen at step #1 (t=0) while loose and before any container has come down. One entry per cube the goal names (one entry for a one-container goal, two for a two-container goal); cubes the goal does not name are not recorded. Written at step #1 and held unchanged for the rest of the episode, even after a cube is hidden by a container or briefly re-exposed when a container is lifted. e.g. [[78, 157], [106, 105]] for a goal that names the blue cube then the red cube.
